item.description:
Layout fixes

  • Fixed the panes overlapping in a narrow window. If the window was smaller than the three columns needed, the task details drew on top of the project pane and text ran off the edge. The window now has a sensible minimum size and the layout adapts instead of breaking.
  • Cost, Paid and Pending now sit next to their amounts in the task details, instead of being stretched apart across the pane.
  • Harmony opens at a size that suits your screen. On a larger display it opens wider, and on a laptop it opens wide enough that nothing has to stack.

If your window is currently very small, resize it once after updating — macOS remembers the size you last used.
